notes: The kit's outputs are git-ignored (brand/.gitignore). recipe.sh writes them into brand/kit/ (lockup-light.png into brand/kit/work/), and the only committed copies are the published ones in home/ and home/brand/. On a clean checkout there is nothing in kit/ to compare the served files with, so serve fails until the recipe has been run here.

The recipes pin vectorcraft-cli 0.7.0, photocraft-cli 0.5.0 and effectcraft-cli 0.6.0, and none of them is installed on any known machine (review 2026-11-02 §2.2; on 2026-11-05 the Studio has 0.17.0, 0.16.0 and 0.17.0). This is a hand-made kit: never rebuild it with other versions or overwrite it with a generated kit (review §8). seal/build-og-seal.py doesn't pin its versions.
recipe.sh reads brand/glyphs/panim.svg, which python3 brand/extract_glyphs.py derives from home/data/morphemes.min.json (git-ignored output).
home/og.jpg (two cups under the compass star) is the site's own share card, from 2026-08-23 (commit ea0b137e4) and older than this kit, so it is not a kit file.

The head block is kit/head-snippet.html. Its theme-color pair follows the OS scheme, and the site's own toggle (data-theme, localStorage cathedral-theme) doesn't repaint it (kit/notes.md). There is no color-scheme meta.
The 255 glossary word pages carry the same head block, written by home/glossary.py. home/proof.html and home/party/ (the previous ai-love.cc page) carry no icon block, so site.html doesn't list them.
The repository has no CI or test script. check.mjs runs by hand (node brand/check.mjs); the repo's .githooks/pre-commit (wired by bin/cathedral hooks) could call it, which is the lane's call.
